description: Virtual Smart Meter Dataset is published by Polytechnique Montréal. It describes simulated electricity profiles and physical characteristics for 200,000 Canadian single-family homes, with 15-minute consumption values and annual end-use breakdowns. Coverage is national within CA. Spatial detail: Individual simulated homes. Temporal coverage: 35,040 observations per annual profile; calendar year not stated. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. Data format is not established in the metadata reviewed. The reuse licence is not stated in the metadata read. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. The homes represent only a subset of Canadian housing. The data are synthetic and the 17 GB archive was not downloaded. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits.
